source: M05 §6.2 rubrics and §6.3 rejection reasons, lite (Oct 2026): the document kind (M02 NID); game_profile and esports_tournament (M21). Kinds are added as their modules arrive (M21 game_profile and esports_tournament). Rows are inserted only when missing. Ground listings (M09): rubric rb_ground_v1 and the ground kind on the shared reasons, plus location_wrong and not_a_venue. M11: the hire_profile rubric and reasons (missing_credential, rate_wrong, profile_details). M20: the gym rubric and the gym kind on the shared reasons (photos, price, duplicate, location, not a venue, incomplete, rules, other). M22: the organisation rubric and reasons.
